notes: The selection is the reviewed Desktop source and version, independent of the dated public latest snapshot.
A 404 snapshot does not establish package privacy.
The verifier checks current resolution, installed patch text, lockfile consistency, and mounts. It does not run the listed acceptance scenarios.
Empty validation.results means no execution evidence has been recorded here. Metadata compatible is not a test result.
Update an npm selection only after carrying Desktop fixes and running its relevant automated and interactive checks.

plugins.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team
plugins.reason: Use the exact public package aligned with Desktop's pinned DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 runtime and its async Agent lifecycle.
desktopContracts: Opt-in Team roster, mailbox and shared task state
No change to the default Desktop Agent behavior

desktopAcceptance: Enable Agent Team, create a session, delegate one bounded task, and disable Agent Team again.
